properties.bcni1995_electorate: Parliamentary electorate of the recommended constituency on the enumeration date, 19 March 1993, as given by the Boundary Commission for Northern Ireland, Fourth Periodical Report (Cm 2949, 1995)

citation: Boundary Commission for Northern Ireland, Fourth Periodical Report on Parliamentary Constituencies and Second Supplementary Report on the number of members to be returned to the Northern Ireland Assembly by each of those constituencies (Cm 2949, HMSO, October 1995; the cover prints 'Cmnd 2949'). Given effect by the Parliamentary Constituencies (Northern Ireland) Order 1995 (S.I. 1995 No. 2992).
checks: The 18 figures sum to the printed total of 1,153,477 (electoral average 64,082). Foyle, Lagan Valley, Mid Ulster, Newry and Armagh, North Antrim, South Antrim and Upper Bann also agree with the 'Total Electorate' lines of the report's constituency schedules.
status: Prepared, not applied. Needs the property join into the FGB and a re-tile of pc-1995 (pc-1995-vector-test).
